levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الأشعري

notes: «بإسناده رفعه» points back to the chain of al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, which this report does not write; no previous report is supplied, so it stays a back_reference.
«رفعه» (raised it) names the Prophet as the end of the saying; the Prophet is not a link.
«حدثنا أبي» names the compiler's father only as «أبي»: a relation link.
